description: This file defines a base activity class for Android applications that handles logging setup and basic lifecycle management, extending FragmentActivity.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class that initializes logging and handles fragment activity lifecycle events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the onCreate method to perform initial setup when activity is created.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Overrides the onStart method to initialize logging when the activity becomes visible.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging by creating a log wrapper and connecting it to the logging chain.
